table.title: The Following Is a List of the Principal Taels Current in China
table.context: The list gives the principal taels in use across China by province and place, with their silver content in grains and their values relative to the Kuping and Tsaoping taels.
transcriber_notes: Transcribed by Claude Haiku 5.5 (via API) from page crops, one reading; not checked by eye.

table.title: Equivalent of the Haikwan Tael in Foreign Currencies, 1910-1921
table.context: The table gives the yearly average equivalent of one Haikwan tael in English, American, French, German, Indian, Japanese, Russian and Mexican money, the basis on which Customs revenue is stated.
transcriber_notes: Transcribed by Claude Haiku 5.5 (via API) from page crops, one reading; not checked by eye.

table.title: [Approximate Exchange Values Between Varieties of Tael]
table.context: Given after the explanation of the Canton tael, this list gives the approximate exchange value of the Kuping, Haikwan and Canton taels against local taels at the principal ports.
transcriber_notes: Transcribed by Claude Haiku 5.5 (via API) from page crops, one reading; not checked by eye.

table.caption_extra: (Number of 10 cash pieces to the dollar)

table.title: [Copper Ingot Imports into Hankow, January 1 to May 19, 1922]
